verses.en: Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.
verses.sm: Atua lo tatou malosi; la outou alalaga i le Atua o lakopo. Ina ucu ja le pese,

verses.en: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
verses.sm: au mai ¡a le topa, © le kitara leo málie, atoa ma le napeli. Ta outou ilia le pu i le masina ua faatoa vaaia,

verses.en: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
verses.sm: o ona po ua tuu e faj ai le tausamiga. A4a c le tulafono lenei mo Isaraelu,

verses.en: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.
verses.sm: o le pule a le Atua o lakopo. Na ia faia lenei mea ma tulafono ia Iosefa,

verses.en: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.
verses.sm: i lona auo atu i le nuu o Aikupito. Na ou faalogo ai i le gagana ou te lei iloa, Na ou tuueseina le avega i lona ua; o 12 ato ua tefa ma ona lima.

verses.en: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.
verses.sm: II 12 13 14 15 Na e valaau mai i le puapuaga,

verses.en: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
verses.sm: ona ou laveaiina ai lea o oe; na ou tali atu ia te oe i le mea lilo ua i ai le faititili; na ou tofotofo ia te oe i le vai o Meripa. Sela.

verses.en: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;
verses.sm: Loʻu nuu e, faalogologo mai ia, seʻi ou ta'utino atu ia te oe; Isaraelu e, e lelei ona e faalogo mai ia te au;

verses.en: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.
verses.sm: aua ne“ ai se atua ese la te oe; aua foi ne“ e ifo i se atua o se nuu ese.

verses.en: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
verses.sm: O aʻu lava o le ALII lou Atua, o le na aveina ae ia te oe nai le nuu o Aikupito; faamaga ia lou gutu, ona Ou faatumuina ai lea.

verses.en: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.
verses.sm: A e lei faalogo mai loʻu nuu i loʻu leo; o Isaraelu foi e lei loto mai ia te au.

verses.en: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: and they walked in their own counsels.
verses.sm: Ona ou tuuina atu ai lea o i latou i o latou loto finau vale;

verses.en: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, and Israel had walked in my ways!
verses.sm: na latou savavali i mea na latou filifili i ai. E! ana faalogo mai loʻu nuu ia te au,

verses.en: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.
verses.sm: ana savavali Isaraelu i oʻu ala; po ua Ou vave faatoilaloina e ua ita ia te i latou,

verses.en: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.
verses.sm: ma aʻu faaoo atu loʻu lima i e ua fai i latou mo latou fili. Po ua faatagā vivii ia te i latou e ua ‘ʻinoʻino i le ALII; a E faavavau o latou aso.

verses.en: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.
verses.sm: Po ua fafaga e ia ia te i latou i le saito e sili ona lelei; po ua ou faama'ona ia te oe i le meli nai le papa.
